attempts.summary: Configured node1's kernel to boot with audit=1 persistently by using grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1", which updated both BLS boot entries (the default kernel and the rescue entry). Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot to prove persistence, confirmed the boot ID changed (real reboot, not just a service bounce), and verified /proc/cmdline and auditctl -s both show audit=1/enabled=1 post-reboot.
